records.notes: V11 is a 2022 ZQ-2 second-batch application article: 836 kN and 60%-110% are historical family references, not a ZQ-3 Y1 performance card. Exhaust entering the nozzle extension is not proof of main-chamber return.

cannot_calculate: Actual TQ-15A vacuum thrust/Isp without this batch's inlet/Pc/geometry/O-F and turbine-exhaust conditions.
Nozzle-extension mixing, restart transient or repeated-use life with the existing steady frozen model.

research_cases.limitations: Single-phase table -> nine neutral ideal-gas species -> chamber-frozen nozzle; no kerosene, pumps, injector feasibility, cycle closure, condensed carbon or experimental validation.

Given thermal states and synthetic methane feeds; geometry/back-pressure and axial branch bookkeeping only. No kerosene or closed-cycle prediction, exhaust-extension mixing, cooling/side-load/life model.
Constant-gamma ideal air formula/software benchmark, not methane or kerosene combustion performance.

missing_value_policy: Missing fields never become numeric solver inputs. This file maps evidence and existing method studies only; it is not a vehicle case file or flight-engine performance dataset.
